query: official road conditions for the Wednesday November 11 Gainesville to Kimball Junction drive on I-10, US-93, and I-15

results.title: UDOT Traffic
results.description: Sunday's gate, at lunch in St. George. I-15 from Cedar City to Nephi, including the 6,600-foot summit between Beaver and Cove Fort, and US-189 through Provo Canyon. Go on only when both show bare or wet pavement. Otherwise stay in St. George.

results.title: UDOT snow tire, chain, and traction device requirements
results.description: Read 2026-10-22. Utah Administrative Code R920-6. When the sign is up, AWD or 4WD needs M+S or 3PMSF tires, or devices on two drive tires. A traction law on I-15 or Provo Canyon is a no-go on this drive.

results.title: AZ 511
results.description: Saturday and Sunday. I-10 from the New Mexico line to Phoenix for blowing dust, and US-93 from Wickenburg to Kingman and on to Hoover Dam.

results.title: DriveTexas
results.description: Friday and Saturday's gate. I-10 from Orange to El Paso. West Texas ice is rare and melts by late morning.

results.title: National Weather Service
results.description: Wednesday and Thursday evenings. Fog, ice storm, or winter storm warnings on I-10 and I-12 along the Gulf Coast. A hold is hours, not a night.
